notes: New: Fire Plan Builder (Designers menu) — assembles an AHJ Fire Safety Plan submission package, starting with Calgary. Fill out a Vital Building Information form matching Calgary Fire's official FD 1019 sheet field-for-field, attach your Base Building Drawings and Fire Alarm Zone Drawings (exported from Drawing Designer) and any Maintenance Certificates, then build one correctly-ordered package PDF. Everything saves as you go — close and reopen a project days later and pick up right where you left off, including mid-form. Export a fill-in-the-blanks Questionnaire PDF at any point to send a customer for whatever info you're missing; dropdown-style questions list their valid answers so it's clear how to respond.
